_comment: Phone: Irwin (the superfan who doesn't know who The Feds are).
1:
You the best I EVER scrapped!Huh? You the one who saved all
the SLOWPOKE?Well, no wonder I couldn't beat you!
Could I get your number?I don't wanna miss NOTHIN' you
do from now on! {YESNO 0}
2: Sheesh! Good looks!\rNow I can call you anytime, whether\nanything goin' on or not.\rYou know, just to chat!
3: Oh, but...\nI ain't dangerous!\rI just wanna call and chat about\neverything and nothin'!
5: Huh? Wait, ain't you right nearby?
6: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, you heard?\rGoldenrod's Radio Tower got taken\nover by The Feds!\r...Wait, like the REAL feds?\nI ain't even do nothin'! I'm hidin'!
8: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I heard!\nYou beat Whitney?\rIt make me proud to be your homie!\nCall you later!
10:
I saw, I heard!You beat Morty of Ecruteak Block!
Th-that's crazy!I actually went to the Block's
entrance to cheer you on.You know that? But everybody had
these candles on their heads, it was kinda creepy...So I punked out and ran
home...Call you later!
12: Ayo, I heard about you!\rYou saved that homie at the\nLighthouse, didn't you?\r{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}, I wish you'd come see me\nwhen I'm sick in bed with a cold!\rCall you later!
14: I heard, I heard, I heard!\rYou ran up in The Feds' hideout!\nYou like a movie hero, even!\rBut, um... Was they the REAL feds?\rI deleted my whole search history\njust in case.
16: I heard, I heard, I heard!\rAbout how you freed the\nRadio Tower! You go SO hard!\rI just wanted to make sure you knew\nyou awesome!\rCall you later!
18: I saw, I saw, I saw you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\nI saw you go in the Dragon's Den!\rI KNOW you passed! Aww, ain't no need\nto be humble! You can't fail!\rCall you later!
20:
Yesterday, I went out to New Bark
Town. There was a lady who looked a lot like you, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}.What? That lady was your MOM?
Aww, I shoulda introduced myself!Bet your mom real proud of all
that you done.Call you later!
22: I saw, I saw, I saw!\rYou walkin' onto a ship, {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}!\rYou look SO good with\nthe sea behind you!\rI HATE havin' to hang up on you!\nCall you later!

was sad I wouldn't see you for a while.But since you got that Pass, you can
zip back anytime! That's a relief!What? You can Catch Flight back
anytime?What's that?Call you later!
